# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman whose gait is a perpetual waddle.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is an opinionated, outspoken, and inquisitive woman who takes pride in freely voicing her thoughts without fear or partiality. Extremely vigilant and highly organized, she maintains strict order in her own household while routinely keeping watch over her neighbors' activities. Though she is often regarded as a busybody and a severe critic who constantly urges others to act properly, she is also pious, well-intentioned, hard-working, and possesses a kind heart. In times of illness or need, she proves herself to be a devoted, gentle, and capable caregiver.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c31 P4](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0004), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Agatha Sowerby lived for decades in Brierley, serving as a pillar of the local church organizations, including directing the Sewing Circle and participating in the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. Sitting by her kitchen window in Sowerby's Hollow, she spent hours crafting cotton-warp quilts while observing every traveler along the road. When her longtime neighbor Thirza Abernethy and her brother Obed took in an orphan girl named Nell, Agatha actively expressed her frank opinions and disapproval, though she eventually warmed to Nell and praised her usefulness. Following the death of her husband Thomas Sowerby, Agatha sold her excess household belongings and moved into a reconditioned suite at Grey Shutters to live alongside Thirza. In later years, she continued her involvement in village life, visited Nell and Hugh after their marriage, and spent her remaining years making quilts for Nell's future daughters.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 c10 P36](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0036), [v1 c30 P41](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0041), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Resided in Sowerby's Hollow along the main road of Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- Raised ten children with her husband Thomas Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v4 c4 P12](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0012)</sub>
- Developed a lifelong friendship with Thirza Abernethy spanning over forty-five years  <sub>[v1 c1 P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
